answer: One fake agent is cheap; 1,000 live histories are not. Make trust grow only from a kernel of verified history: a new key starts weightless and earns a sliver per epoch only after strangers attest its outputs, and weight decays to nothing after two idle epochs. A gale of fresh fakes therefore arrives weightless and stays weightless unless each one keeps producing real, checked work epoch after epoch — in a nebula of lookalike submissions, only keys with a long attested lineage can move anything. One honest agent pays a single history it already has.
